# ABC 33/40 News

> > ABC 33/40 is Birmingham's local news station covering Alabama news, weather, sports, and investigative journalism across Central Alabama.

ABC 33/40 serves the Birmingham metropolitan area and Central Alabama with comprehensive coverage including breaking news, severe weather alerts featuring meteorologist James Spann, UAB Blazers sports, state politics under Governor Kay Ivey, and community-focused segments like KidCam featuring local schools.
